Selection Step Parameters

Source: R/parameter.R
select_control.Rd

Creates a parameter object controlling the shadow stability selection step of mf.

Usage

select_control(
  mtry_factor = 1,
  mtry_rule = "auto",
  mtry_on_real = FALSE,
  min_ntree = 500L,
  ntree_factor = 1,
  shadow_mode = "split",
  n_reps = 50L,
  pi_thr = 0.6,
  pi_thr_unassigned = NULL,
  threshold_mode = "pi_thr",
  shadow_percentile = 95,
  unassigned_modules = NULL,
  use_cfres = FALSE,
  cfres_n_folds = 5L,
  cfres_ntree = 300L,
  cfres_scope = "unassigned",
  early_stop = FALSE,
  early_stop_tol = 0.01,
  early_stop_check_every = 10L
)

Arguments

mtry_factor

mtry multiplier for random forests. Default 1.

mtry_rule

How mtry is derived from the feature count. One of "auto" (default), "sqrt", "p_over_3". See screen_control. Unlike screening, a single stability selection run can fit BOTH classification and regression forests even though y is one fixed type. For instance, when use_cfres = TRUE, any pool that gets cfRes residualized (see cfres_scope) turns continuous for that pool's own forest.

mtry_on_real

Logical. If TRUE, mtry on the augmented \([real | shadow]\) matrix is 2 * rule(p_real) so real feature sampling is not diluted by the shadows. Default FALSE.

min_ntree

Minimum trees per forest. Default 500.

ntree_factor

Trees per forest scaling factor. Default 1.

shadow_mode

Shadow stability pooling strategy. One of "split" (correlated and unassigned pools evaluated separately) or "within_module" (one shadow run per module). Default "split".

n_reps

Number of subsample replicates for shadow stability (each draws half the rows without replacement). Default 50.

pi_thr

Stability frequency threshold for correlated pool features. A feature is selected if its shadow win rate across replicates exceeds pi_thr. Default 0.60.

pi_thr_unassigned

Stability threshold for the unassigned pool. NULL (default) uses an automatic elbow detection rule. We recommend keeping this NULL.

threshold_mode

Selection cutoff rule. "pi_thr" (default) uses the fixed pi_thr for the correlated pool and elbow detection for the unassigned pool. "elbow" applies the adaptive elbow rule to both pools.

shadow_percentile

Percentile of the shadow feature distribution used as the importance threshold within each replicate. Default 95.

unassigned_modules

Character vector of module names treated as the unassigned pool (e.g. "M10_unassigned"). Names must match values in module_membership; a name that matches no module gives a warning. NULL disables split pool logic.

use_cfres

Logical. If TRUE, a cross fitted random forest is used to residualize y before the unassigned pool stability step, reducing confounding from correlated modules. Default FALSE.

cfres_n_folds

Number of cross fitting folds for cfRes residualization. Default 5.

cfres_ntree

Trees per fold forest in cfRes residualization. Default 300.

cfres_scope

Scope of cfRes residualization. "unassigned" (default) applies cfRes only to the unassigned pool. "all_modules" applies per module cfRes to every module (removes the contribution of all other modules before that module's stability run).

early_stop

Logical. If TRUE, stop the replicate loop once selection frequencies converge. Default FALSE.

early_stop_tol

Convergence tolerance for early_stop: stop when the largest change in any feature's frequency between batches falls below this. Default 0.01.

early_stop_check_every

Replicates per batch. Convergence is checked between batches. Default 10.

Value

An object of class select_control.

See also

screen_control, mf

Examples

#> [1] 1
#> 
#> $mtry_rule
#> [1] "auto"
#> 
#> $mtry_on_real
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
#> $min_ntree
#> [1] 500
#> 
#> $ntree_factor
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> $shadow_mode
#> [1] "split"
#> 
#> $n_reps
#> [1] 50
#> 
#> $pi_thr
#> [1] 0.6
#> 
#> $pi_thr_unassigned
#> NULL
#> 
#> $threshold_mode
#> [1] "pi_thr"
#> 
#> $shadow_percentile
#> [1] 95
#> 
#> $unassigned_modules
#> NULL
#> 
#> $use_cfres
#> [1] FALSE
#>

#> [1] 5
#> 
#> $cfres_ntree
#> [1] 300
#> 
#> $cfres_scope
#> [1] "unassigned"
#>

#> [1] FALSE

#> [1] 0.01
#> 
#> $early_stop_check_every
#> [1] 10
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "select_control"
